newsitem.title: ITALY: De Benedetti, Tesone in Ivrea probe of Olivetti.
newsitem.headline: De Benedetti, Tesone in Ivrea probe of Olivetti.

text.p: Former Olivetti Chairman Carlo De Benedetti and the current chairman Antonio Tesone are under preliminary investigation by Italian magistrates in a probe of the company's accounts, judicial sources said.

Financial manager Corrado Airaudo is also under investigation, alongside chief executive Francesco Caio, in the probe being carried out by magistrates in the north western town of Ivrea where Olivetti is based, the sources said.
Judicial sources said on Monday Caio was under investigation in the preliminary inquiries which are all linked to the group's first half 1996 results published two weeks ago.
The questioning is the first step of an investigation which could lead to a full-scale criminal inquiry.
Olivetti, which has not broken even since 1990, reported a further first half loss for 1996 two weeks ago at the same time as De Benedetti resigned as chairman, although he remains honorary chairman.
A senior manager at the group resigned a day after the results announcement saying he did not agree with all the figures in the financial statement.

Since then bourse watchdog Consob has been carrying out its own investigation into the state of Olivetti's financial affairs while the Ivrea magistrates' probe is the result of a complaint filed against the group by an association of small shareholders.
